card.name: Start of drug or condition abbreviations
card.fires_on: The first letter piece (mostly M or R) that begins a capitalized drug name or condition abbreviation such as MDD, MDS, MHD or Ropinirole, usually after for, with, of or to in dosing text.

modes.label: M at start of MDD/MDS/MHD
modes.description: The letter M opens a condition or metabolite abbreviation after for, with or of.
modes.example: the dosing recommendations for AUVELITY are as follows: For<< M>>DD, the recommended starting and maximum dosage

modes.label: R or M at start of a drug name
modes.description: A single capital letter begins a drug name split into pieces, after of, to or coadministration of.
modes.example: Table 2. Dose Titration Schedule of<< R>>opinirole Tablets for Restless Legs
